response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_modindex, s.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_average FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_average, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying
